name: Cooling Towers
desc: Hyperboloid power-station cooling towers standing on a lower band, each billowing a plume of steam that rises, drifts on the wind and dissipates for ever while a drifting sky light catches its lit side; the towers sit low and the steam climbs into open frame — weathered concrete, a dusk silhouette with underlit vapour, thermal false-colour, a schematic, or an engraving.

energy.doc: how thick and bright the steam plumes read and how the light catches them

scale.doc: tower size — min a distant plant on the horizon, max huge foreground towers

density.doc: how many towers (2 to 4) and how much steam each pours out

speed.doc: how fast the steam rises and recycles

wind.doc: wind strength — how far the plumes shear sideways and how tall they climb

x.doc: centre of the group across frame

y.doc: base line the towers stand on — steam climbs above it into open frame

style.doc: aesthetic: weathered grey concrete with white steam / a dusk silhouette with warm underlit vapour / thermal false-colour / a cyan schematic / a hatched engraving plate

seed.doc: site lottery — tower depth, placement, staining and per-blob steam phase

alpha.doc: layer opacity — scales every mark so it dissolves into the background rather than veiling it
